## Read in Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
```

## Read in data

```{r}
SAM <- st_read(here("oahu_solar_dedup_simple.geojson"))
```

## Map the data

```{r}
mapview(SAM)
```

## Retrieve census data

```{r}
library(tidycensus)

oahu_median_household_income <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  variable = "B19013_001",
  state = "HI",
  county = "Honolulu",
  geometry = TRUE,
  year = 2022)

```

```{r}
mapview(oahu_median_household_income,
        zcol = "estimate")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = oahu_median_household_income,
       aes(x = moe, y = estimate)) + 
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```

## Homework

```{r}
solar <- st_read("oahu_solar_dedup_simple.geojson") %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(3563) %>%
  mutate(area_m2 = as.numeric(st_area(.)))
```

```{r}
summary(SAM$area_m2)
nrow(SAM)
```

```{r}
ggplot(SAM, aes(area_m2)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of solar polygon areas (log scale)",
       x = "Area (m²)", y = "Count")
```
